desc:
The Daycare was taken over by a Giant Baby and we need to escape! But we need to be quiet because we don't wanna wake him up and get him mad!

Let’s find a way out of this crazy daycare!

With over 23 fun obby stages to escape, can you survive?

If you enjoyed the game, please leave a like and favorite – it means a lot!

Join the group for a FREE surprise reward!
